entries.en: Angelet looks at you expectantly.
entries.fr: Angelet a une proposition à vous faire.
entries.ja: イディルシャイアのアンジェレトは、冒険者が声をかけるのを待っているようだ。

entries.en:
You speak with Angelet, who makes a seemingly innocent request─with her magicked cloth in hand, she asks you to relive the fiercest battles of your past. The only condition, however, is that you do so at the scene of battle, as that is the only way to quicken the magicks of her fabric. Though the locales she insists upon are likely still teeming with danger, you are not one to balk at a challenge. And so you make haste to the sites of your past adventures.

※The key item can be obtained by clearing a dungeon via Duty Roulette: High-level Dungeons.

Angelet vous a remis , qu'elle vous a demandé d'emporter avec vous sur le lieu d'un de vos combats récents les plus acharnés, puis de vous remémorer votre victoire pour qu'elle s'imprègne de vos souvenirs. Rapportez-lui alors l'étoffe pour qu'elle vous donne  en échange.
Accomplissez une “mission aléatoire : donjons avancés” pour obtenir .
* L'objet ne peut être obtenu que dans le cadre de la quête “Au service d'Angelet”.

entries.en: Your stroll down memory lane was fraught with peril, but both you and Angelet's magicked cloth remain none the worse for wear, and surprisingly no different. Which seems peculiar since, according to Angelet, there should be some discernible difference in the cloth. Perhaps she can explain what, if any, change has taken place.

entries.en:
Angelet is beaming with excitement upon your return, and the reason for her elation gives you pause. As she explains it, her profession is the crafting of dolls using cursed materials. What was once an ostensibly normal bolt of fabric is now replete with the pain and suffering of your fallen enemies. As promised, she bequeaths to you the singing cluster you desire. In the event you cross paths with her again, you remind yourself not to ask after her merchandise.

※This repeatable quest can be undertaken once daily. Upon completing the quest, it will become available again the following day at   (Earth time).

entries.en: You see, I make poppets for a living, and my materials must be cursed before I can work. A curse on its own is only wishful thinking, but with a little death, misery, and a touch of magic, my dolls can become so much more. They will look so pretty dressed with this beshrewed fabric. Such tricks they will play.
entries.fr: Oh, ne vous en faites pas, c'est exactement ce dont j'ai besoin. En fait, je me sers de ces morceaux d'étoffe pour créer des poupées un peu spéciales, qui servent de talismans pour dissiper la rancœur et la haine qui habitent certaines personnes.
